changelog: - **Keyboard focus in Storage and privacy, the phase popover, and the Relations focus ring.** In Storage and privacy, moving to a confirmation step or back to the list left the keyboard focus on the page; it now goes into the step, and back to the button that opened it. The run row's phase popover could open by itself at the next phase after its button had gone from under the pointer; it now stays shut until it is pointed at or pressed again. A focused Relations row now shows its ring in high-contrast (forced colours) mode, and a focused Relations link shows a ring in every mode instead of only changing colour.
